name: aitranslate
description: AI-powered hover documentation translation for any language (Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Java, C++ ...) using any OpenAI-compatible API

pythonHoverTranslator.apiKey.description: (Legacy) API key. Prefer the visual settings panel — the key is stored securely in the OS keychain instead. This plain-text setting is only used as a fallback.

pythonHoverTranslator.apiUrl.description: Custom OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint URL. Examples: https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions, https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions

pythonHoverTranslator.cacheSize.description: Maximum number of cached translations (LRU eviction)

pythonHoverTranslator.model.description: Model name to use (e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini, qwen2.5:7b)

pythonHoverTranslator.maxTokens.description: Max tokens for the API response. Some models cap this (e.g. GLM-4V-Flash max 1024).

pythonHoverTranslator.showOriginal.description: Show original English hover content alongside translation

pythonHoverTranslator.showExamples.description: Include code usage examples in the translated hover

pythonHoverTranslator.proxyUrl.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for the API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890). Leave empty to use HTTPS_PROXY env var or direct connection.

commands.title: AI Hover Translator: Clear Translation Cache
